Account & Password FAQ
Domain: User account management and login support.
Dataset purpose: This document is a sample knowledge-base source for a Multimodal
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) FAQ system.
The visual above is intentionally embedded so the data-extraction module can detect and extract images from the PDF.

Q1. How do I reset my password?
Open the login page and select Forgot Password. Enter your registered email address and follow the reset
link sent to your inbox. Create a new password and sign in again.

Q2. What should I do if I do not receive the reset email?
Check the spam or junk folder first. Confirm that the email address is correct. If the message is still missing,
wait a few minutes and request another reset link.

Q3. Can I change my password while logged in?
Yes. Open Account Settings, select Security or Change Password, enter the current password, and then
enter the new password twice.

Q4. Why is my account temporarily locked?
An account may be temporarily locked after repeated unsuccessful login attempts. Wait for the lock period
to end or use the supported account-recovery procedure.

Network & Connectivity FAQ
Domain: Basic network and internet troubleshooting.
Dataset purpose: This document is a sample knowledge-base source for a Multimodal
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) FAQ system.
The visual above is intentionally embedded so the data-extraction module can detect and extract images from the PDF.

Q1. Why does my device show 'No Internet'?
First check whether other devices can access the internet. If all devices are affected, restart the router and
check the service connection. If only one device is affected, reconnect that device to the network.

Q2. How can I reconnect to Wi-Fi?
Open the device's network settings, select the required Wi-Fi network, enter the correct password, and
reconnect.

Q3. Why is my internet connection slow?
Possible causes include a weak wireless signal, many connected devices, background downloads, or
network service issues. Move closer to the router and test the connection again.

Q4. What should I check before contacting support?
Record the device name, network name, approximate time of the problem, error message, and whether
other devices are also affected.

Software Installation & Setup FAQ
Domain: Application installation and initial configuration.
Dataset purpose: This document is a sample knowledge-base source for a Multimodal
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) FAQ system.
The visual above is intentionally embedded so the data-extraction module can detect and extract images from the PDF.

Q1. What should I check before installing software?
Check the supported operating system, available storage, required permissions, and any documented
prerequisites.

Q2. Where should I download an installer from?
Use the official software source or another source explicitly authorized by the software provider. Avoid
unknown download locations.

Q3. What should I do if installation stops with an error?
Read the exact error message, verify available storage and permissions, and restart the installation. Record
the error if support is required.

Q4. Why does the application not start after installation?
Check whether the application meets its system requirements. Restart the device and review any startup
error message.

Security & Safe Usage FAQ
Domain: Basic account and application security practices.
Dataset purpose: This document is a sample knowledge-base source for a Multimodal
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) FAQ system.
The visual above is intentionally embedded so the data-extraction module can detect and extract images from the PDF.

Q1. How can I identify a suspicious login page?
Check the website address carefully and verify that the connection uses HTTPS. Be cautious of unexpected
messages asking for passwords or one-time codes.

Q2. Should I share my OTP with support staff?
Do not share passwords or one-time authentication codes with another person. Use the official support
process if you need help.

Q3. What should I do after clicking a suspicious link?
Do not enter credentials on the suspicious page. Close it and follow your organization's or service provider's
security-reporting procedure.

Q4. Why should I use a strong password?
A strong password makes unauthorized access more difficult. Use a unique password for important
accounts and follow the service's password requirements.

Multimodal RAG FAQ System - Technical FAQ
Domain: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, document retrieval, images, and answer generation.
Dataset purpose: This document is a sample knowledge-base source for a Multimodal
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) FAQ system.
The visual above is intentionally embedded so the data-extraction module can detect and extract images from the PDF.

Q1. What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)?
RAG combines retrieval and generation. The system first retrieves relevant information from a knowledge
base and then provides that information to a language model to generate an answer.

Q2. Why does this project use a multimodal RAG approach?
Many FAQ resources contain both text and visual information such as screenshots, diagrams, and error
images. A multimodal system can use both forms of information during retrieval and answer generation.

Q3. What happens after a user submits a question?
The question is encoded for retrieval, relevant knowledge-base content is retrieved and ranked, and the
selected context is passed to a multimodal language model to generate a response.

Q4. Why are citations important?
Citations connect an answer to the source information used to produce it. They allow users and developers
to verify where the answer came from.

Q5. What should the system do when the answer is not present in the
retrieved information?

The system should avoid inventing an answer and clearly indicate that the available retrieved information
does not contain the required information.
